content.about: Slovenia is a small country where the Alps, the Mediterranean and the Pannonian plain meet. More than half of it is forest. Lake Bled, with a church on its island, is one of Europe's most photographed places. It has a short but busy Adriatic coast.

standout.text: The Postojna Cave system has more than 24 km of passages and a cave railway.

didYouKnow: The olm, a blind cave salamander, can live for about 100 years.
Lipizzaner horses come from Lipica in Slovenia.
